body: Ang pinaka-worth exploring dito ay hindi lang headline PMI kundi sabay na pag-angat ng orders, exports, backlogs at hiring. Bea is right na kailangan ng official confirmation, pero habang hinihintay iyon, useful leading question: saan unang lalabas ang strain kung real ang cycle—machine-tool lead times, skilled hiring, supplier capacity, o equipment backlogs? Doon natin makikita kung survey optimism lang ito o may physical bottleneck nang nabubuo sa factory floor.
